entities.summary: Independence, Partition, and Early Crises, a transformative movement in Pakistan (1947–1958). Catalyzed Muhammad Ali Jinnah (Quaid-e-Azam) dies just 13 months after independence and First Indo-Pakistani War over Kashmir ends with a UN ceasefire line.
